actions.result_status: No matching Tract hyperscale/data-center project record found in targeted public searches for Tract, Tract Yuma, Yuma Tract campus, and hyperscale. Exact public search for data center returned older unrelated Yuma records, including a 2014 local data-center mechanical permit, not a new Tract campus.

actions.result_status: Local reporting cited the mayor's clarification that data centers were of interest to Yuma but no applications or permit requests had been submitted to the city for approval.
actions.access_caveat: Local public-radio report; not a city record, but it describes the mayor's public clarification and council-retreat discussion.

actions.government_body: Greater Yuma Economic Development Corporation / Yuma-area public meeting
actions.result_status: GYEDC/local reporting said data-center interest was linked to possible energy infrastructure, but no projects had been sited or were under review; discussions with developers were underway.
actions.access_caveat: Regional media report of public meeting and GYEDC statements.
actions.evidence_note: Corroborates preliminary-interest status without project-specific approval.

actions.result_status: Tract's own public projects page lists Arizona Buckeye, not Yuma; the Buckeye page identifies the Buckeye Technology Park as owned and in development at 2,019 acres and 1,800 MW capacity on the west side of Buckeye.
actions.access_caveat: Developer website; absence of a Yuma listing is treated only as negative evidence, not proof that no private discussions exist.
actions.evidence_note: Suggests the legacy Tract/Yuma lead may be conflating Yuma, AZ with Yuma Road in Buckeye/Maricopa County.

contradictions.details: Public Tract and industry sources verify a Tract Buckeye Technology Park near/associated with Yuma Road in Maricopa County, while no official Yuma, Arizona application or Tract Yuma listing was found. Treat the legacy Yuma lead as possible place-name conflation until a primary Yuma record appears.
